policies.with_check:
(workspace_private.s04_target(school_id, handover_id, revision) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM workspace.school_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.school_id = handover_acknowledgements.school_id) AND (m.id = handover_acknowledgements.membership_id) AND (m.epoch = handover_acknowledgements.epoch) AND (m.actor_id = workspace_private.actor())))))

(workspace_private.s04_create_allowed(school_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM workspace.school_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.school_id = handover_notes.school_id) AND (m.id = handover_notes.created_by) AND (m.epoch = handover_notes.created_by_epoch) AND (m.actor_id = workspace_private.actor())))))

((state = 'pending'::text) AND workspace_private.session_ok() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM workspace.school_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.id = join_requests.membership_id) AND (m.actor_id = workspace_private.actor())))))

policies.qual:
(workspace_private.admin(school_id) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM workspace.school_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.id = join_requests.membership_id) AND (m.actor_id = workspace_private.actor())))))

((state = 'pending'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM workspace.school_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.id = join_requests.membership_id) AND (m.school_id = join_requests.school_id) AND (m.actor_id = workspace_private.actor())))))
policies.with_check:

   FROM workspace.school_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.id = join_requests.membership_id) AND (m.actor_id = workspace_private.actor())))))

policies.qual:
(workspace_private.allowed(school_id) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM workspace.school_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.id = membership_terms.membership_id) AND (m.actor_id = workspace_private.actor())))))

(workspace_private.admin(school_id) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM workspace.school_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.id = membership_terms.membership_id) AND (m.actor_id = workspace_private.actor())))))

policies.with_check:
(workspace_private.session_ok() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM workspace.school_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.id = membership_terms.membership_id) AND (m.actor_id = workspace_private.actor())))))
(workspace_private.session_ok() AND (actor_id = workspace_private.actor()) AND (role IS NULL) AND (status = 'pending'::text))

(workspace_private.session_ok() AND (workspace_private.admin(school_id) OR ((actor_id = workspace_private.actor()) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['left'::text, 'pending'::text]))) OR ((actor_id = workspace_private.actor()) AND (role = 'SCHOOL_ADMIN'::text) AND workspace_private.promotion_allowed(school_id, id))))

(workspace_private.s07_permission(school_id,
CASE type
    WHEN 'RECEIVE'::text THEN 'inventory.receive'::text
    WHEN 'USE'::text THEN 'inventory.use'::text
    WHEN 'ADJUST'::text THEN 'inventory.adjust'::text
    WHEN 'DISPOSE'::text THEN 'inventory.dispose'::text
    ELSE 'inventory.manage'::text
END) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM workspace.school_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.school_id = shared_inventory_movements.school_id) AND (m.id = shared_inventory_movements.actor_membership_id) AND (m.epoch = shared_inventory_movements.actor_epoch) AND (m.actor_id = workspace_private.actor())))))

   FROM workspace.school_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.school_id = shared_inventory_movements.school_id) AND (m.id = shared_inventory_movements.actor_membership_id) AND (m.epoch = shared_inventory_movements.actor_epoch) AND (m.actor_id = workspace_private.actor()))))))

 'requests',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',j.id,'member_code',m.member_code,'requested_role',j.requested_role,'version',j.version,'requested_at',j.requested_at) ORDER BY j.requested_at),'[]') FROM workspace.join_requests j JOIN workspace.school_memberships m ON m.school_id=j.school_id AND m.id=j.membership_id WHERE j.school_id=s AND j.state='pending' AND j.epoch=m.epoch)) INTO v;RETURN v;END

functions.body:
DECLARE v jsonb;BEGIN
 IF NOT workspace_private.session_ok() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated_or_revoked';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x.school_id),'[]') INTO v FROM(
 SELECT m.school_id,m.id AS membership_id,m.member_code,m.role,
 CASE WHEN z.state='recovery_locked' THEN 'recovery_locked' WHEN m.status='active' AND m.valid_until<=statement_timestamp() THEN 'expired' ELSE m.status END AS status,
 m.valid_until,m.approved_at,m.version,m.epoch,z.name AS school_name,
 (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',j.id,'version',j.version,'state',j.state,'requested_role',j.requested_role,'requested_at',j.requested_at) FROM workspace.join_requests j
 WHERE j.school_id=m.school_id AND j.membership_id=m.id AND j.epoch=m.epoch ORDER BY j.requested_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS request
